query:
UPDATE salonOrderItems soi
JOIN salonOrders so ON soi.orderId = so.id
SET soi.status = 'CANCELLED'
WHERE so.status = 'CANCELLED'
AND soi.status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'READY');
